tldr: For the fixed maintained H4 primitive class, the full-horizon causal RMST contrast admits uniform Gaussian inference over the entire closed class in the critical censoring window \(\kappa_n=3+\zeta/\log n\). One total data-only estimator attains the sharp all-procedure local MSE constant \(V_\zeta(\eta)=K(\eta)\int_0^{1/12}e^{\zeta v}dv\), continuously \(K(\eta)/12\) at zero, at scale \(\sqrt{n/\log n}\). The proof includes terminal-cell learning, legal projection, nonlinear four-moment reconstruction and the complete event-plus-censor likelihood. Separately labeled fixed-exponent experiments have a sharp root-\(n\) subcritical row and a matched supercritical MSE exponent \(12/(\kappa_{\mathrm f}+9)\). The exact supercritical constant is the sole residual phase question.
gap: Regular adjusted survival inference uses adequate follow-up and nuisance-rate control. Class-sensitive irregular-functional theory does not, in the inspected sources, give the exact local constant for this finite-smoothness causal endpoint experiment with two unknown hazards and two unknown censor channels.
fill: A complete original-record converse and a full-class learned-channel reconstruction determine the sharp variance and feasible Gaussian precision for the unchanged causal contrast.
